All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Ability
Represents the set of capabilities that an item can contain These capabilities are represented by the enumeration constants and used to determine what actions are available
Action
Abstract parent class for concrete class PackAction and UnpackAction
ActionCapable
Interface for any class that uses the method allowableActions
Application
Implement the Application class Creates Moon object to run the simulation Core class to get the whole program running
Backpack
Implements Backpack class Represents a Backpack that stores Items for CrewMember The Backpack has a weight limit and items can be added or removed
Bottle
Implements the bottle subclass create Bottle object with super class attributes with addition of capacity Override toString method to output capacity as well
Consumable
Represent an item that can be consumed by the crew member Classes implementing this has to contain the consumedBy method
ConsumeAction
Implements a ConsumeAction class that allows crew member to consume a consumable item
CrewMember
Implement CrewMember class Represents a crew member in the simulation with a name, backpack, and initial energy
FlashLight
Implement FlashLight subclass
Item
Implements Item class creates Item object with brand and weight attributes Parent class for FlashLight, Lockpick, Bottle, SterilisationBox
Lockpick
Implement Lockpick subclass
Menu
Implements a menu showing all allowable actions for the CrewMember to execute returns the corresponding Action object that has been selected Has a static method so it can be called without instantiate a Menu object
Moon
Represents the moon in the simulation Contains scattered items on the surface that the crew member can pack
NutCan
Represents a canned nut item that can be consumed by a crew member This item increases the crew member's energy when consumed
PackAction
Implements the PackAction subclass creates a PackAction object with item attribute represents an action where the crewMember packs an item into their backpack
SterilisationBox
Implement SterilisationBox subclass
TortillaPack
Represents a pack of Tortilla pack that can be consumed by a crew member Can only be consumed when the crew member posses the STERILISE capability
UnpackAction
Implements the UnpackAction subclass Creates an UnpackAction object with item attribute Represents an Action object where the CrewMember unpacks items onto the moon
